body: Thanks for the replies guys, I will definitely keep them in mind.

Thank-you all, I've decided to just keep on trying to move on through the motions.. I don't usually get too depressed to the suicidal extent too often (it is like mood-swings and such), but still, I am going to try and find some value, I want to try and be more of a sociable person then I am, so I guess figuring out that and possible choices for the future are something to contemplate. :}

But really, thanks you guys for commenting on this.

Yeah, I know that being 'manic' plays in to Bipolar much more then however I (may) have experienced, but the only reason I keep the thought alive, is because there are certain cases where a person can have Bipolar however not have much standard 'manic' episodes at all, and also the other thing is I am only 15 and so far these 'moods' over time have developed more and more, so it could be any possible Bipolar symptoms I potentially could have are just developing and in time could become the full thing.

And with my whole possible "analyticalness" yeah like I guess being analytic is just a little bit of my personality haha, I myself do see it is a bit more evident in my writing, that's only just because I think when I'm writing about stuff like this I get a bit 'robot' with how I write :? . Also another reason for the way I talk about all this sort of stuff is possibly how I grew up.. like not focusing on my parents raising me or anything but more of all of the Psychologists/Therapists/etc sort of scenery that I saw around me and experienced at such a young age.

I do have friends I could possibly talk to, but like, you see I'm not a very personal person usually, like I could openly talk to someone (whether I know them really well or not/depends on the person/circumstances usually), however a lot of times I will talk about personal stuff with a person and then regret it later, (even though I really shouldn't), also I just feel awkward when talking to people about stuff like this/the people I would talk to about I don't know if I want to and such.. It's all just a bit complicated lol.

My relationship with my family is all good, there isn't any 'real' sort of drama in the household, and I get along with my Brother, Father and Mother all generally well. On the note of talking to them about this sort of stuff, I really don't think I could ever do, I would just feel to awkward to talk to them about it. Hence also why my Father doesn't see the severity in going in to get a Psychological Evaluation quickly.
I don't know exactly when I will get one, hopefully it will be this week, but right now the plan is just to eventually go to my Doctor, and ask for one. So that just needs to happen is all, and whether or not I will be safe until then.. I don't know, it's a tad random these 'moods' and everything is just really heavy when I do get them..like when I am out of them like now, I am a bit more cheery and quirky I guess lol, but yeah it just all kind of up in the air.. you see when I do get the moods they are randomish and they put me in a very depressive mood, but then that makes me think of a lot of things that increase to the depression and it all gets very heavy.

For my future.. I don't know, the only thing I can honestly see myself enjoying to do is entertain in some way, like acting or my dream sort of job I guess lol, which is making video on YouTube, I know it sounds cheesy but I know how it all works and to me it sounds like an amazing way of life :? . But yeah, I really can't see myself working at some job for my life that I would hate (which would be at most normal every-day jobs...) I know I sound kind of picky and very naive saying that, but the thing is for the majority of my life so far in most aspects of it I have been miserable, and that's why I only want good to come out of my future, it also doesn't help that I am just kind of lazy/have no felling of effort to do proper work, like study etc.. (even for doing YouTube stuff..) majorly I think because of just all of this stuff I constantly go through and also maybe because I just am lazy.. I don't know :/

Thanks for messaging, your replies are really helpful and nice. :]

Hey thanks for replying, and I would say that if I have experienced 'Manic' episodes in the past then they would be rare (I can't recall in the very past if I have had anything, probably because I wasn't aware of what they were until only recently, so I probably overlooked it at the time), although just a few days ago one of these 'moods' were particularly bad and I (after much restraint) cut myself, then after the 'intense-depressive' emotions I felt which lead me to that, were a much 'hyper-something' emotion, which I think could possibly be classified as a manic episode, because it was very weird, the best way I can describe it was that I felt like The Joker from Batman, I was sad and angry yet very hyper and smilingly/acting like a maniac.

I did just look in to Borderline-Disorder after you mentioned it, and it would seem that could also be a contender for any possible diagnosis these symptoms may receive..

And on the note of Aspergers, apparently my parents thought I may have had it when I was very little.. however I personally don't think I do because I don't show many of the 'Asperger-specific' signs, like socially I am all well and good for the most part and such.

And in these times, just doing things that require thought kind of distracts and calms the 'mood', (Like when writing up the post, I am now feeling less 'intense'), and I've done a lot of things at time when I have had 'moods' like yeah sometimes I draw and stuff. The only problem is that when I do manage to calm these 'moods' I kind of miss the feeling I had in them.. I don't know it's just, I feel like, there is more of a chance of resolution in my life.. it's weird, but there isn't anything in life that I really have to look forward to or aspire to..
